real_use_case: Create the CANONICAL_VARIANTS re-entry artifact by assigning deterministic reference-bound identities to successfully normalized E1A SNV and indel records.
upstream_status: Project-owned deterministic identity contract over the verified GRCh38.p14 normalization output; no external executor or mutable nomenclature standard defines the identifier.
license: Independent project-owned implementation; no third-party implementation or data bytes are copied or redistributed.
supported_profile: Successful reference-bound normalization output for the pinned NCBI RefSeq GCF_000001405.40 / GRCh38.p14 primary-autosome E1A SNV and small-indel profile.
resource_budget: O(n) time and O(n) output memory over normalized records; no network, subprocess, external database, or reference-byte loading.
output_contract: CanonicalVariantIdentityResult containing a CANONICAL_VARIANTS artifact, deterministic reference-bound variant IDs, and normalization/source provenance links.
known_issues: HGVS, rsID and gene identifiers are deliberately excluded from canonical variant identity; HGVS remains a later versioned projection, while gene identity and evidence annotation are separate capabilities.
security: Pure deterministic in-memory processing of already validated normalized VCF bytes; no filesystem reads, subprocess, network, dynamic code execution, or external mutable identifier lookup.
disable_path: This capability is not wired to a default execution pipeline; reject any input whose normalization attestation, pinned reference binding, record domain, uniqueness, or provenance contract is not exact.
